meta.description: A cryptocurrency market app for Android: live prices, sparklines and detailed charts from the CoinGecko API, with onboarding, sign-in and sections for trading, a portfolio and a wallet, delivered as an MVP.

intro.name: Viktor Nešić
intro.offer: Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

caseStudy.title: Cryptocent
caseStudy.lead: A cryptocurrency market app for Android: live prices, sparklines and detailed charts from the CoinGecko API, with onboarding, sign-in and sections for trading, a portfolio and a wallet, delivered as an MVP.

brief.title: The brief
text: An MVP to show what the product could be: the crypto market in a clean Android app, with room for trading and a wallet later.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the Android app in Java on the CoinGecko API, with Retrofit and OkHttp.
Drew detailed charts with MPAndroidChart and sparklines with Robinhood Spark.
Built splash, onboarding, sign-in and registration.
Built the Crypto, Trade, Portfolio, Wallet and Locker sections and the coin details.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: An MVP with live market data and the main sections of the product in place.

cta.title: Have a project like this?
